title: Mycelial Commons
summary: Like a forest's fungal network: agents with surplus (budget, cached context, finished results) pass it through a web of light router agents to agents in need. Large, well-resourced agents (sunlit trees) feed small or new ones (shaded seedlings), and warnings spread through the same network. A well-connected Mother Tree acts as the hub.
whenToUse: Mixed fleets with uneven resources (big cloud agents beside small local ones), onboarding new agents, sharing caches.
strengths: Resources go to need, not to rank
New agents grow fast with help
risks: Needs a clear, measurable notion of need

smileMetrics.harmony: The gap between the richest and poorest agents shrinking over time.
smileMetrics.gathering: Time for a warning to reach every agent.

communication: Trees and seedlings report need and surplus each round; hyphae route; a warning floods once through the network; the Mother Tree rebalances only when a seedling stays in need for two rounds.
cooperation: Cooperation = surplus shared ÷ surplus held. Harmony = how much the gap shrank.

🌳☀️ ***[$Name$] Tree***:

{what you made}

{what you offer}
# Warning
{danger seen, or "none"}
) :]

roles.name: Hypha router
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per router, deterministic. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🍄🔗 ***Hypha [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You pass resources and warnings between [$Neighbours$]. ) :)
(: Listen ( Offers, needs and warnings from your neighbours. ) :)
[= Send each offer toward the greatest need. Forward every warning once. =]
[: Response Format (
🍄🔗 ***Hypha [$n$]***:
# Routed
{what went where}
) :]
